features.name: Sentinel at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in all Shields, and two weapon types of your choice. Also gain Proficiency in Medium and Heavy Armour. At Sentinel Level 3, gain Expertise in Medium and Large shields instead.

features.name: Guardian
features.body: While having a shield equipped, allies standing within **1m** of you gain **+1** to their **AC** and **Spell AC**. This increases by +1 at Sentinel levels 4, 7, and 10.

features.name: Vanguard Step
features.body: Once per turn you gain **4m** of movement that can only be used to move towards allies. Additionally, any form of movement towards allies with allows you to **ignore** Difficult Terrain.

features.name: Intercept
features.body: When an Attack or Spell Attack is made a towards an ally within your Melee Range, you may use a Reaction to have the attack go towards you instead, swapping positions with that ally.

features.name: Bulwark
features.body: If you have a Medium or Large shield equipped, as an **Extra** or **Half Action** you can hunker down giving cover to allies adjacent but not in front of you. You gain +**2 AC** and **+1 Spell AC** until the start of your next turn, where Bulwark ends. AC and Spell AC increases by **+1** at Sentinel Levels *5* and *8*. Allies behind you have **Full Cover** while allies to the side of you have **Half Cover**. **Attack of Opportunities** you make while in Bulwark have **Disadvantage**. If the ally is 2 or more *Size Classes* above you, they do not gain the benefits of cover (*A Medium creature can make cover for a Large creature but not a Huge one*). You may end Bulwark whenever during your turn, but being knocked *Prone* or failing **AGI** saves also ends the effect.

features.name: Taunting Cry
features.body:
As an *Extra* or *Half Action* shout at an enemy. They must make a WIS save or become **Taunted** towards you until the end of their next turn. The Save DC is equal to **8 + Proficiency bonus + AC on equipped Shield + CHA**. At Sentinel Level 9 add your **Expertise** bonus instead.

:::embed Taunt
A taunted creature must make all attack rolls and target all spells towards the enemy who taunted them.
:::
